label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The weekly rollup calculation uses `startOfWeek(now, user.timezone)` which relies on `startOfWeek` starting the week on Sunday instead of Monday, causing the email to be considered due on Tuesday morning for users in time zones like Sydney where Monday corresponds to the first day of the week.
